attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion where the human anatomy becomes a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual source hair: short, thick, dark black/brown hair brushed up and back, revealing a high and receding forehead, with real brow hair. The face is bareheaded with no separate moustache, beard, or glasses; the mouth is serious and closed. Maintain the source-exposed light grey/green open uniform collar and lapel folds over a pale grey inner shirt edge, with subdued dark central neckwear, limited by the foreground note. Retain the actual small-card pale grey clothing and deep facial side shadow, preserving the low-key light and exact primary head roll. Keep the actual pale grey uniform and dark source hair. No invented prominent red collar badge or regalia hidden by the note; preserve only tiny source-exposed fittings. The rounded chin must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short, broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open or closed garment and fastening, with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual source color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct in the source must stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED head in exact source slight angle, short thick DARK BLACK/BROWN hair brushed up/back with high/receding forehead, real brow HAIR, smooth upper lip/chin with no separate moustache/beard or glasses, serious CLOSED mouth. Source-exposed LIGHT GREY/GREEN OPEN uniform collar/lapel folds over pale grey inner shirt edge and subdued DARK central neckwear, mostly limited by foreground note. Retain actual small-card pale grey clothing and deep facial side shadow, keeping the uniform. No invented prominent red collar badge or regalia hidden by note; preserve only tiny source-exposed fittings. Exact primary head roll, outfit fastening, light and crop govern.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Do not copy human long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy; fit the original neckline around the compact round head. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small primary/nearest-pixel zoom, full raw master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Dark swept-back short hair, real brow hair, clean serious closed face, primary side shadow, pale grey/green open uniform folds/pale inner shirt/dark neckwear and opaque frame/backing/note remain. However the lower yellow face tapers too far into a pointed V over the dark tie rather than ending in a compact rounded short chin immediately on a broad fitted collar. Queue one separate exact-master builtin art repair of this geometry, retaining actual open uniform folds and dark source hair/shadow. Fine hidden collar emblems are not invented or a rejection reason.
